feedback_text: The mathematics lectures this term were clear and well paced.
The projector in seminar hall B has not worked for two weeks.
The canteen is open from 8 AM to 5 PM on weekdays.
Wi-Fi in the girls' hostel keeps dropping every evening and nobody has fixed it.
The librarian helped me find three journal papers in ten minutes. Thank you!
The staircase near the lab is slippery and someone could get injured. Please fix this urgently.
The bus to the north route arrives 40 minutes late almost every day.
The fee payment portal accepted my payment without any trouble.
Good teaching but the classrooms are far too hot to concentrate.
Great. Another cancelled class. Exactly what I wanted.
The placement talk is scheduled for Friday at 2 PM in the auditorium.
